description: This Java source file defines the class CopyTableWorker which extends SwingWorker to copy table data to clipboard in a Swing application.

classes.name: CopyTableWorker
classes.description: A SwingWorker subclass that copies data from a Table object to the system clipboard asynchronously.

methods.name: CopyTableWorker
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CopyTableWorker with a Table object.

methods.name: doInBackground
methods.description: Performs the copying of table data to the system clipboard in a background thread.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Resets the cursor of the window and table after copying is complete.
